record.issue_text: Migration join assumes embed_category stored a category name; if it stored a category id, every migrated host silently falls back to uncategorized

adjudication.rationale: The migration `20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` derives `category_id` via `INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'`, which assumes the stored `embed_category` value matches `categories.name`. If an existing install stored something else (e.g., an id, slug, etc.), the query yields no rows and `category_id` becomes 0, triggering the fallback to `uncategorized_category_id`, potentially mis-migrating host-category mappings. The diff does not prove what format `embed_category` was historically stored in, but the migration is clearly format-dependent and could silently fall back.
